channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Falk | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Falk from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Cuban on David Falk
item.description:
“The day he signed with the Washington Wizards to come back, David Falk — that’s right when I was buying the Mavs — said ‘why don’t you go meet him?’”

Mark Cuban on David Falk, May 6, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Michael Jordan on David Falk
item.description:
Jordan says in Episode 5.

“Nike made this big pitch. And Falk was like, ‘You gotta be a fool if you’re not taking this deal. This is the best deal.’”

Michael Jordan on David Falk, May 4, 2020. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Dikembe Mutombo on David Falk
item.description:
“Falk tried to work with us in terms of trying to acquire other players (to clear money).The organization at the time just didn’t have the resources. It’s that simple. Because if we could have kept that group together, that was a pretty good team.”

Dikembe Mutombo on David Falk, Sep 12, 2015. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on David Falk, Dikembe Mutombo
item.description:
According to Bickerstaff there was a lot of work being done behind the scenes to secure Mutombo’s stay in Denver.

“David Falk and those guys, they tried to work with us because Mutombo, he wanted to stay,”

JB Bickerstaff on David Falk, Dikembe Mutombo, Sep 12, 2015. Source: Denver Post.
